leadText: Sunflora (Japanese: キマワリ Kimawari) is a non-player character in and . She is a member of Wigglytuff's Guild.
plainText:
Sunflora (Japanese: キマワリ Kimawari) is a non-player character in and . She is a member of Wigglytuff's Guild.

==Background==
Sunflora has been an apprentice at Wigglytuff's Guild for at least quite some time, apparently being already an apprentice a long time before the and their , and calling the two 'cute', implying she's also older than they are.

She is one of the most gifted apprentices at the Guild, as shown when she is chosen to apprehend Haunter, who was thought to be invincible. She was also given the chance to graduate once, but turned it down in favor of more training.

She has a rocky relationship with Loudred, shown in both the main storyline and the special episode "Today's Oh My Gosh", the cause of which is never directly revealed, but her diary suggests this might be because Loudred got her knocked out of a dungeon once by storming off recklessly. This is shown in her often making rude remarks about Loudred. An example is when Loudred commented on what he would do if he lost his memory, during the strategy meeting at Foggy Forest, saying it wouldn't matter because he's forgetful anyway. Her diary entries about the events of the special episode, however, claim she has warmed up to Loudred a little after this. She still makes occasional rude remarks to Loudred after this though.

She later reappears in Super Mystery Dungeon as a recruitable character.

==Personality==
Sunflora often acts very hyper and excitable, using terms like "Oh my gosh" frequently when speaking. Underneath her girly exterior, however, she is very kind and loyal to her guild members, shown when she saved part of her dinner along with the other guild members to present to the hero and partner when they had been denied dinner. She keeps a diary in her crew room which documents the events occurring in the storyline from her perspective.
 
===Diary===
Sunflora's Oh My Gosh Diary documents events of the storyline, provides some tips for the game, and breaks the fourth wall once, akin to Bidoof's Yup Yup Journal. When the hero is exploring the waterfall, the diary has four entries, as seen in Sunflora's special episode.

===Moves used===
 
Sunflora will always have in Today's "Oh My Gosh" and cannot forget it, as the move is used in a cutscene.

In the graduation exam and Bidoof's Wish, Sunflora is guaranteed to know Petal Dance and Leaf Storm respectively. The 3 other known moves will vary between all moves Sunflora can learn up to level 35 and 50 respectively.
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Appearance===
 

==In animation==
 ]]
In Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness, Sunflora joined Team Poképals in their mission to acquire a Gabite Scale. While she proved to be an asset in teaching and the basics of exploration, she was eventually put out of commission by Gabite's .
